message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The facts: a police officer (state staff) accepted bribes (507,100 yuan) from hotel manager to protect hotel engaged in prostitution. Also he abused his power by giving tip-offs to help hotel evade anti-prostitution raids. So crimes: "受贿" (bribery) and "滥用职权" (abuse of power). In examples, they used "受贿;滥用职权". For state staff, they sometimes differentiate "受贿" vs "非国家工作人员受贿". Here he is a police officer, a state employee, so "受贿". Also "滥用职权". So answer: [罪名]受贿;滥用职权<eoa>.
